name: ::TRAYCRAFT:: NOVEMBER UPDATE
description:
🎮 TrayCraft: Crossplay Survival, Modded Feel, No Mods Needed

Java or Bedrock, PC, phone, or console: everyone plays together, with a custom resource pack on both editions.

Join: play.traytovenmusic.com

Java port 25565 · Bedrock port 19132 · Version 26.3

🏛️ The Colosseum: PvE and PvP Arena

• PvE Waves: squads of up to 8 fight 100 rounds with a boss every 5, from the Creeper King to the Wither Storm. Earn Tray Tokens and spend them at the Armory and Mystery Chest on perks and power-ups.

• Boss Rush: back-to-back bosses, solo or with a squad, each with its own leaderboard

• PvP modes: Free for All (up to 16 players), Last Team Standing (up to 4v4v4v4), Gun Game, Hardpoint, One in the Chamber, Sheep Quest and Stocks

• Plus a Weekly Challenge and Practice modes for PvE and PvP

• Bet on matches, climb K/D and leaderboard holograms, and get into the Hall of Fame

• Winners earn crowns and titles like [Tradiator] and [Trexterminator], plus arrow trails

• Open it all with /colosseum

🦃 November Update

• Turkey Hunt: sneak up on wild turkeys in the Dappled Forest, chase the rare Golden Turkey, and climb the season leaderboard for the [Top Gobbler] title (all November)

• 43 new survival enchantments: 3x3 mining, auto smelting, replant, harpoons, shield and armor perks, and Grounding to knock gliders out of the sky

• Wearable 3D neck chains in gold, rose gold and iron, plus Bust Down diamond chains. No armor slot needed.

🎰 Casino and Bar

• 17 games: roulette, blackjack, Texas Hold'em, slots, Plinko, Mines, crash, craps, baccarat, Sic Bo, Cup Pong and more

• 8-ball pool: 1v1, 2v2, or take on NPC hustlers from Easy to Max

• Casino ATMs, purple high-roller tables, a bartender and waiters with 36 drinks, weekly leaderboards, a daily free spin and 100+ casino advancements

⚔️ Adventure

• Hunger Games matches with elytra contrails, join from anywhere with /hg join
